entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath planeswalker and Ravnican Guildpact who learns of Vraska's odd planeswalk from Ral and then leads the Gatewatch to Kaladesh.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: An Izzet mage with an electric gauntlet who secretly keeps tracking planeswalks through Project Lightning Bug and warns Jace.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who tells Jace that Tezzeret is alive on Kaladesh and asks him to bring the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch fetched by Jace and who helps in the arena fight.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who leaps into the arena to save her mother Pia from Tezzeret.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who fights beside Chandra and tells her it is over when Tezzeret flees.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker with a double axe who rescued Chandra and Nissa and has followed Tezzeret's movements for weeks.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: An older renegade ally of Chandra who is saved by Ajani and supported by his fur.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother and the renegade leader, forced to duel Tezzeret in the arena as bait.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker and Head Judge of the Inventors' Fair with a metallic right arm who duels Pia and uses the Fair to confiscate every invention.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A scarred Consulate officer who taunts Pia before her duel.

entities.name: Consul Kambal
entities.description: A consul on the airship Skysovereign who receives thopter images of Chandra and orders Baan to prepare a confiscation.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An elven inventor who won top prize at the Fair, taken with her invention.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A renowned inventor who alerts Chandra and Pia that all Fair inventions and Rashmi have been taken.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who planeswalked from Ravnica to no known destination and has not been seen since.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Jace's Azorius guard who thinks he is in his office.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon guildmaster, from whom Ral hides the Lightning Bug results.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Pia's late husband.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: The inspector told to prepare the confiscation.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker alliance that reunites on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government of Kaladesh whose soldiers serve Tezzeret.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of Ral and Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose performers entertain at the carnarium.

entities.name: Skysovereign
entities.description: Tezzeret's huge airship with an aether cannon that eclipses the arena and takes him aboard.

entities.name: Project Lightning Bug
entities.description: An Izzet experiment to detect planeswalks, officially shut down but secretly still running.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: The Kaladeshi festival ended by Tezzeret's confiscation of its inventions.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Jace and Ral meet.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where Tezzeret holds power.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane Jace visited before Innistrad.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane Jace visited after Zendikar.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The capital city of Kaladesh.

entities.name: Dhund
entities.description: The Consulate prison from which Chandra's group escaped.

entities.name: Hall of the Guildpact
entities.description: Jace's official offices on Ravnica where visitors are recorded.

entities.name: Ghirapur arena
entities.description: The arena where Chandra was almost executed as a child and where Tezzeret duels Pia.

events.summary: Ral Zarek privately meets Jace at a Rakdos show to tell him about an irregular planeswalk.
events.quote: An irregular planeswalk.

events.summary: Ral explains that Vraska left Ravnica for no destination, as if into a void, and has not been seen since.
events.quote: She didn't planeswalk to a plane. Only from one.

events.summary: Ral reveals he can still detect when Jace leaves Ravnica, and chides him for leaving the Guildpact.
events.quote: First to Zendikar, then off to Innistrad, was it?

events.summary: Ral warns Jace that others would love his position and to make more effort.
events.quote: Just remember there are those who'd love to be in the position you've blundered your way into.

events.summary: Liliana appears and tells Jace that Tezzeret is alive and well on Kaladesh.
events.quote: Tezzeret. Alive and well.

events.summary: Liliana demands that Jace come to Kaladesh and bring the muscle, then planeswalks away.
events.quote: Come to Kaladesh. Bring the muscle.

events.summary: Jace abandons Ral and goes to fetch Gideon.
events.quote: dodged down an alleyway to fetch Gideon.

events.summary: Ajani tells Nissa he has followed Tezzeret's movements on Kaladesh for weeks.
events.quote: We've been following Tezzeret's movements here for weeks.

events.summary: Banners across the city advertise a showdown between Head Judge Tezzeret and the renegade criminal Pia Nalaar the next noon.
events.quote: INVENTORS! COME WITNESS THE SHOWDOWN OF THE CENTURY.

events.summary: Chandra decides to face Tezzeret's challenge despite the risk of another trap.
events.quote: He's calling me out,

events.summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
events.quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

events.summary: Ajani asks what the Gatewatch is.
events.quote: What's a Gatewatch?

events.summary: A thopter photographs the group and delivers the images to Consul Kambal aboard the Skysovereign.
events.quote: one that showed the target, Nalaar, daughter of Renegade Prime

events.summary: Kambal tells the courier to inform Inspector Baan that the bait is set and the confiscation can be prepared.
events.quote: Alert Inspector Baan. The bait is set. Prepare the confiscation.

events.summary: Pia, manacled backstage at the same arena where Chandra was almost executed, hopes her daughter stays away.
events.quote: This was the place where Chandra had searched the stands for her mother before being torn out of the world.

events.summary: Baral taunts Pia, telling her Chandra's rescue attempt went awry in the wrong place.
events.quote: They came looking for you. In the entirely wrong place, sadly.

events.summary: The announcer declares Rashmi top prize winner of the Fair and prizewinning inventions are quietly taken by guards.
events.quote: An announcer was proclaiming that Rashmi had won top prize at the Fair

events.summary: The duel starts with Pia and Tezzeret each given a container of basic parts.
events.quote: Let the showdown...begin!

events.summary: Pia's booby-trapped servo destroys the legs of Tezzeret's crawler.
events.quote: The servo burst in a small sphere of smoke and pieces, and blew the legs off the crawler.

events.summary: Tezzeret's devices devour her parts, kill her thopter and he summons an army of automatons around her.
events.quote: Bands of metal curved unnaturally at his will, coiling in on themselves to become a small squad of other sharp-legged automatons.

events.summary: Tezzeret declares he will mete out justice and sets his automaton to kill Pia.
events.quote: I will mete out proper justice for yours.

events.summary: A bolt of fire from the audience fells the attacking automaton; Chandra has intervened.
events.quote: The bolt of fire had streaked out of the audience

events.summary: Chandra leaps into the arena, refusing her mother's order to leave and declaring she will not lose her again.
events.quote: And I'm not losing you again!

events.summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
events.quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

events.summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
events.quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

events.summary: Jace warns that Tezzeret's blocked mind means he was prepared and they have made a mistake.
events.quote: if he knew to block his mind, it means he was prepared for this.

events.summary: Chandra compresses a blinding point of fire to kill Tezzeret as Liliana urges her on.
events.quote: Chandra's fist closed, compressing fire into a tiny point of blinding, seething heat.

events.summary: The Skysovereign eclipses the arena with its turret ready to fire.
events.quote: A stark shadow passed over the arena

events.summary: Tezzeret announces the end of the Inventors' Fair and rises into the airship, retreating.
events.quote: And this concludes the Inventors' Fair, everyone.

events.summary: Nissa tells Chandra it is over, and Chandra runs into her mother's arms.
events.quote: Her mother held her arms open. Chandra ran and fell into them.

events.summary: Saheeli tells Chandra and Pia that the inventions of the Fair and Rashmi are gone.
events.quote: I think they took Rashmi and the others

events.summary: Pia says Tezzeret's duel was a distraction and Ajani says he is building something.
events.quote: He's building something

relations.note: He defeats and tries to kill her in the duel.
He taunts her before the duel.
relations.quote: Ready to do your part, Nalaar?
The Izzet mage who sat down next to him wore a mizzium gauntlet

relations.note: Ral says she was none too fond of Jace.
relations.quote: Vraska was none too fond of you, last I heard.

relations.note: One of the Gatewatch on Ravnica.
relations.quote: while the rest of the Gatewatch, Jace and Gideon, remain on Ravnica.

relations.note: One of the Gatewatch on Ravnica.
relations.quote: while the rest of the Gatewatch, Jace and Gideon, remain on Ravnica.

relations.note: He rescued her and she calls him a good man.
relations.quote: That was a very good thing you did, Ajani.
Consul Kambal set the thopter down on a desk.
